title: Alternating Harmonic Series Conditional Convergence
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether sum_{n=1}^oo (-1)^(n-1) / n converges absolutely, conditionally, or diverges.

steps.title: Check Absolute Convergence
steps.explanation: The series of absolute values is the divergent Harmonic Series (p = 1).

steps.title: Apply Alternating Series Test
steps.explanation: Terms are positive, strictly decreasing, and approach 0.

steps.title: Conclude Classification
steps.mathExpression: \text{The series converges, but not absolutely } \implies \text{Conditionally Convergent}
